public_evidence: The task requires no rendering when arrows leave fewer than one track cell, but the test expects arrows in a two-cell area.
The task requires DOUBLE_VERTICAL as the default, but a failing test expects the single-line track symbol.
The current thumb mapping divides position by content_length minus viewport, allowing a legal terminal position to map beyond the available track.
Style Reset versus None may be a representation detail and was not yet checked against existing patch semantics.
diagnosis: Stronger tests exposed both real behavior defects and newly introduced oracle defects; treating all red tests as production failures would corrupt a contract-faithful implementation.
release_condition: Correct contract-conflicting tests, independently repair terminal thumb mapping, validate style semantics, and rerun the strong suite with failure categories recorded.
